name: Kirkland Signature Frozen Shelled Edamame (Soy/Fiber Warning)
whyItWorks: Whole young soybeans contain 6 grams of dense insoluble fiber and galacto-oligosaccharides per cup. Whole legumes resist complete breakdown and can induce severe gas pressure and mechanical irritation in narrowed bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: High Fiber & Gas Warning: Avoid if experiencing bloating or strictures. In remission, eat small portions and chew thoroughly.
